system.description:
True art is found only through despair, revealing the path to Nirvana.

LEVEL 3

Hurt Me Twice. (1/turn) Suffer a Wound. Repeat the next spell you cast for free.

Repent. You may recover an additional Wound when you Safe Rest. +2 max Wounds.

LEVEL 7

Out of Time. (1/Safe Rest) When you Field Rest, you may recover a Wound.

The End is Nigh. (1/turn) Suffer a Wound. Reduce the mana cost of your spell by the number of Wounds you have for the rest of your turn.

LEVEL 11

Precipice of the Abyss. While Dying, you cannot gain more than 1 Wound from a single instance, and ignore STR saves when casting spells.

LEVEL 15

Sell the World. (1/encounter) Action: Expend any number of Hit Dice. Heal or damage a creature within Range 12 equal to the amount rolled, then recover a Wound.
